summary: Verified 'Pizza du mois' fix end-to-end via Admin editor UI + customer menu (FR & DE, desktop & mobile) + dynamic PATCH switch + reset. All 5 acceptance checks PASS. Backend enforces single 'moment' (auto-unflag previous). Customer Pizzas section renders in the forced order: Pizza du mois (with badge product-month-<id>) → Créer votre pizza → regular pizzas. Diavola appears only once in 'Tout'. No orders were created or modified during testing (last order timestamp is prior to test start). All products reset to highlight=null at the end (0 products flagged 'moment' in final GET /api/menu).
critical_code_review_comments: index.tsx sections builder correctly (a) prepends any product flagged highlight='moment' inside the Pizzas section regardless of its category (line 97-100) and (b) filters it out of every other section (line 102), so a moment product from a non-Pizza category would also appear once in Pizzas – behaviour matches the spec.
server.py PATCH /api/products/{id} unflags previous 'moment' before setting the new one (line 702-703) – uniqueness maintained even when clients only send {highlight:'moment'}.

Minor UX: after tapping 'Enregistrer' in the product editor, an ephemeral toast 'The action GO_BACK was not handled' shows when the editor was reached via deep link – noted in the request as expected and to be ignored.
seed_data_creation: None. Test only mutated product.highlight fields on 4 pizzas (Quattro Stagioni, Margherita, Diavola, Calabrese) via the Admin UI and one PATCH; all reset to null at end.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Manager PIN 1234 works (staff-pin-input testID). Product editor deep link /staff/admin/product/<id> works after login. Menu polls every 8s – 10s wait is enough to see PATCH changes reflected in the UI. Backend PATCH auto-unflags previous 'moment'. PrintNode is LIVE; never create/accept orders. Do not run pytest suites.
rca_of_issue: Original bug: 'Pizza du mois is not appearing first in Pizzas'. Fix (verified): (1) frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx now builds the Pizzas section as [moment products, custom-pizza products, other pizzas], forcing order 1 for the flagged product regardless of its natural sort/category; (2) backend/server.py PATCH /api/products/{id} atomically clears any other product's highlight='moment' before applying the update, guaranteeing uniqueness across all admin edit paths. Reproduction confirmed and fix confirmed on live preview URL.
